EVENT_DEVICE_STATUS.name: device-status
doc: Payload for the `device-status` JSON event.

fields.name: connected
doc: True while the tuner is open and streaming.

fields.name: error
doc: Reason for the disconnect; absent from the wire when there is none.

EVENT_REPLAY_POSITION.name: replay-position
doc: Payload for the `replay-position` JSON event. Emitted at ~25 Hz
by the replay reader so the transport slider stays in sync with
the IQ file read head (see [`crate::replay`]).

fields.name: sample_idx
doc: Read-head offset in IQ samples from the start of the file.

fields.name: position_ms
doc: Read-head position in milliseconds.

fields.name: total_ms
doc: Total capture duration in milliseconds.

fields.name: playing
doc: True while the transport is running, false when paused.

EVENT_SCAN_COMPLETE.name: scan-complete
doc: Payload for the `scan-complete` JSON event. Emitted when a full sweep
finishes without hitting the squelch threshold (see `docs/TIMELINE.md` Phase 9).

EVENT_SCAN_STEP.name: scan-step
doc: Payload for the `scan-step` JSON event. Emitted after each successful
retune so the frontend can keep `radioStore.frequencyHz` in sync with
the hardware. All display components (FrequencyAxis, FilterBandMarker,
FrequencyControl) read from that store and update automatically.

fields.name: frequency_hz
doc: The logical target frequency (Hz) — after lo-offset correction,
matching what the user sees as the tuned centre.

EVENT_SCAN_STOPPED.name: scan-stopped
doc: Payload for the `scan-stopped` JSON event. Emitted when the scanner
halts early because a step's peak power exceeded the squelch threshold.

fields.name: frequency_hz
doc: The frequency (Hz) at which the signal was detected.

EVENT_SIGNAL_CLASSIFICATION.name: signal-classification
doc: Payload for the `signal-classification` JSON event.
Emitted at ~2 Hz by the DSP task. See `docs/SIGNALS.md §5.4`.

fields.name: confirmed
doc: Wire-name of the spectrally confirmed mode (`"FM"` / `"NFM"` /
`"AM"` / `"USB"` / `"LSB"` / `"CW"`), or null when SNR is too
low. Maps to a green ModeSelector button.

fields.name: candidates
doc: Wire-names from the frequency prior; always populated for known
bands regardless of signal strength. Map to yellow buttons.

fields.name: reason
doc: Human-readable explanation of the decision.

EVENT_SIGNAL_LEVEL.name: signal-level
doc: Payload for the `signal-level` JSON event. Emitted at ≤ 25 Hz,
rate-limited with peak decay (see `MIN_LEVEL_EMIT_INTERVAL` in
`src-tauri/src/ipc/dsp_task.rs`).

fields.name: current
doc: Instantaneous level in dBFS (post-channel-filter baseband RMS; see `docs/DSP.md` §2).

fields.name: peak
doc: Decaying peak-hold level in dBFS.
